calls.video_title: Get Paid Every Month Without Selling a Share
calls.thesis: Main Street Capital: lends to smaller private companies, never cut its regular monthly dividend since 2007; the only monthly dividend stock that made his list, keep it small.
calls.base_case: Never cut its regular monthly dividend since 2007; 5-yr total return beat the S&P.
calls.bull_case: Reliable monthly payer with a long no-cut record.
calls.bear_case: Sold first when investors fear private lending; fell ~64% in the 2020 COVID crash.
